description: Ejes viales is a dataset listed in Uruguayan spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (IDEuy), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Uruguay (IDEuy). Capa vectorial de ejes viales a nivel nacional, elaborada por la Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales del Uruguay (IDE), a partir de imágenes obtenidas durante el relevamiento aerofotogramétrico realizado en los años 2017 y 2018, así como de múltiples fuentes oficiales y no oficiales verificadas. Coverage: Uruguay. Its tags are Ejes viales, vías de circulación, vialidad, direcciones, viales. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-ideuy-portal.
